key_insight: ProIQA evaluates math item quality by modeling the solving process, not just the problem stem, to assess educational value more faithfully.
engineering_relevance: It offers a scalable pipeline for automated quality control of generated math questions in intelligent tutoring and AIG systems.
method: Builds a process-enhanced IQA dataset by adding structured reasoning trees to original items
Uses LLMs to extract hierarchical solution trees from raw solutions
Encodes process structure with GNNs and fuses it with stem semantics in a dual-view model
evidence_signal: Experiments on K12 math datasets show the framework captures process-oriented features and supports fine-grained assessment across knowledge, difficulty, and competencies.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of LLM-generated reasoning trees and the reliability of structured solution parsing.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
